visual.title: A spiral from a complex eigenvalue
visual.caption: Near a fixed point the Jacobian gives a linear system. A negative real part with a nonzero imaginary part produces a stable spiral, and the trajectories rotate inward.

predict.question: A linearisation has eigenvalues minus 0.5 plus or minus i. What is the local picture?
predict.explain: The real part is negative, so trajectories decay, and the imaginary part makes them rotate. The fixed point is a stable spiral.
